question: Which bombs were used by IAF during the air strikes in Balakot on 26th February 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Spice-2000 bombs**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Indian Air Force (IAF) used **Spice-2000 bombs** during the Balakot air strikes conducted on 26th February 2019.
 
• The Spice-2000 bombs are precision-guided munitions that belong to the **Smart Precise Impact and Cost-Effective (SPICE)** family of bombs.
 
• These bombs are designed and manufactured by Israeli defense technology company **Rafael Advanced Defense Systems**.
 
• The Spice-2000 bombs used by the IAF have a penetration capability, enabling them to destroy hardened targets such as bunkers and concrete structures.
 
• These bombs are equipped with advanced navigation and targeting systems, making them highly effective in precision strikes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Balakot Air Strikes**

 
 
• The Balakot air strikes were conducted by the IAF in response to the Pulwama terror attack that occurred on 14th February 2019.
 
• The strikes targeted a Jaish-e-Mohammed (JeM) terrorist training camp located in Balakot, Pakistan.
 
• This operation marked the first time since the 1971 Indo-Pak war that the IAF crossed the Line of Control (LoC) for an air strike.
 
• The mission was carried out by a formation of 12 Mirage 2000 fighter jets.
 
 
 
• **SPICE Family of Bombs**
 
 
• SPICE stands for Smart Precise Impact and Cost-Effective.
 
• It is a family of standoff air-to-ground glide bombs.
 
• SPICE bombs are designed for precision targeting, using electro-optical and GPS guidance.
 
• The family includes SPICE-2000, SPICE-1000, and SPICE-250, indicating the weight of the bombs in pounds.
 
 
 
• **Rafael Advanced Defense Systems**
 
 
• Rafael Advanced Defense Systems is an Israeli defense technology company.
 
• It develops and manufactures a wide range of advanced defense systems for air, land, sea, and space applications.
 
• Rafael is known for its cutting-edge technologies in areas such as missile systems, electronic warfare, and precision-guided munitions.
 
 
 
• **Mirage 2000 Fighter Jets**
 
 
• The Mirage 2000 is a multirole combat aircraft developed by Dassault Aviation of France.
 
• It is known for its agility, precision strike capability, and versatility in various combat roles.
 
• The IAF operates Mirage 2000 jets, which have been upgraded with advanced avionics and weapon systems.
 
• These jets played a crucial role in the success of the Balakot air strikes.
